description: This file defines a React component 'ThemedAgGridReact' that wraps the 'AgGridReact' component, applying custom theming based on Apache Superset's theme context. It manages dark/light mode, theme overrides, and exports related types and modules for ag-grid integration.

classes.name: ThemedAgGridReact
classes.description: A React component that wraps AgGridReact, applying Superset theming and supporting dark/light modes, theme overrides, and forwarding refs.

methods.name: ThemedAgGridReact
methods.description: React functional component that applies dynamic theming to AgGridReact based on current theme and mode, with support for theme overrides.
